notes: SOUND PASS ACROSS THE WHOLE GAME: real 3D sound - you can hear if a shot or footstep is in front, behind, above or below you. Walls and floors muffle sound.
Every map has its own acoustics: long echoing reverb in the hospital and the airport terminal, tight rooms in the killhouse, open air with echoes on outdoor maps. Far-away gunfire sounds distant.

Guns hit harder with a fuller low end. New bullet impact and ricochet sounds on walls, and a thud when you hit a body. A close explosion leaves your ears ringing; at low health the world sounds muffled.
Footsteps match the floor: tile, snow, grass, sand, wood and stairs. A cleaner master mix that doesn't distort.
Zombies have real voices now: moans, a screech when they swing and a gurgle when they die. The hospital hums, drips, creaks and has something screaming somewhere far off.
CO-OP AMMO IS SHARED: ammo dropped by zombies shows up for everyone, and whoever grabs it picks it up for the whole squad. Buying the Ammo Crate refills the whole squad too.
CO-OP SOUND: you now hear your teammates' gunshots (they were silent before), their footsteps, their grenade explosions and their punches.
